operations.description: Validate the closed finite TU-game envelope, player set, coalition table, dividends and zero-real-world fields.

Return the exact characteristic-function table over all coalitions.

Compute the exact Shapley allocation from dividends and a permutation-marginal comparator.
Certify that exact Shapley shares sum to the grand-coalition value.
Classify null players from all exact marginal contributions without inferring social standing.
Partition players by identical exact marginal-contribution signatures.
Reconstruct every coalition value from the exact dividend decomposition.
Enumerate finite player orders and retain exact marginal-contribution traces.
Measure every coalition excess at the synthetic Shapley allocation and certify the bounded core condition.
Check all disjoint coalition pairs for exact finite superadditivity.
Check all coalition pairs for exact supermodularity in the frozen finite game.
Verify exact Shapley covariance under a declared positive integer scale.
Verify that a frozen bijective player relabeling transports values and shares without semantic promotion.

Check exact efficiency and individual rationality for the synthetic allocation.
Represent an accessible synthetic grant-allocation analogy while refusing fairness or policy authority.
Retain the absence of participants, observed preferences, consequences and affected-party review.
Hold every real grant, funding, legal, cultural and community-allocation action behind exact competent authority.

boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner cooperative-game software and documentation evidence only; no real allocation, participant observation, independent reproduction, empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, complete privacy, accessibility or security assurance, consciousness, personhood, Theory-of-Everything proof or Stage 20 readiness.
